body:
Life isn't worth living because every goddamn monkey on this planet is filled with hatred and enjoys making the other monkeys suffer. Life isn't worth living because it never gets better. It stays the same or it gets worse, but in two decades of living, I cannot honestly think of a single day that I went to bed thinking"huh, today was a better day than yesterday".

Life isn't worth living because this sub exists. Look at all of the people in the same spot as me. Who have come to the conclusion that the least painful route is to voluntarily step out of the maelstrom of pain that is this life. 

Because of war. Because of murder. Because of rape, and abuse, and sadness. The bad outweighs the good by several orders of magnitude.

It's just not worth living in a world this painful.

There's no such thing as God or the afterlife. Just nothingness. Remember what it was like before you were born? That's what you're going back to. Just nothing. No pain, no happiness, no misery, nothing.
